specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond = numbers.length

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_pos_of_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    numbers ≠ [] → longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_result_is_valid_subseq_len
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    let allSubseq := (numbers.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.contains (longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_is_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    let allSubseq := (numbers.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.all (· = longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_two_increasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond [a, b]),
    a = b → longestIncreasingSubsequence [a, b] h_precond = 2

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_two_nonincreasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond [a, b]),
    ¬(a = b) → longestIncreasingSubsequence [a, b] h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond numbers (longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_append_ge
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (x : Int) (h1 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers)
      (h2 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (numbers ++ [x])),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h1 = longestIncreasingSubsequence (numbers ++ [x]) h2

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_ge_zero
specs.stmt:
∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers),
    0 = longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_sorted_eq_length
specs.stmt: ∀ (numbers : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond numbers), List.Pairwise (· < ·) numbers → longestIncreasingSubsequence numbers h_precond = numbers.length
